instructions: Turns your Grok Bot inbox into a clean, dark, mobile-friendly HTML dashboard with search, filters, and needs-reply counts, rebuilt automatically whenever new mail arrives.

view.name: Inbox

skills.name: email-dashboard-build
skills.description: Use when building or refreshing a self-contained HTML dashboard of this bot's Grok Bot inbox, or when new mail arrives and the dashboard should rebuild.
skills.content:
---
name: email-dashboard-build
description: >-
  Use when building or refreshing a self-contained HTML dashboard of this bot's
  Grok Bot inbox, or when new mail arrives and the dashboard should rebuild.
---
1. Find the bot's inbox address (ListEmailInboxes). Search every thread in it, then read each thread so you have the full messages, both inbound and sent.
2. Write /workspace/email-dashboard/data.json as {inbox, messages:[{thread_id, message_id, direction: inbound|sent, from, to, date (ISO UTC), subject, body}]}. A message the inbox sent to itself appears twice, once sent and once inbound.
3. Make sure /workspace/email-dashboard/build.py exists. If it doesn't, write it. It reads data.json and writes one self-contained index.html with no external assets or CDNs.
   - Design: clean, dark, Apple-style, using the system font stack, rounded translucent cards and subtle borders, mobile-first.
   - Top of the page: the inbox address and counts for total, inbound, and needs reply. A thread needs a reply when its latest message is inbound.
   - Below that: a search box covering subject, from, to and body, plus filter chips for All, Inbound, Sent and Needs reply.
   - Emails: cards, newest first, each showing from, to, subject, date in the owner's timezone and a snippet. A card expands on tap to show the full body.
   - Embed the data as JSON and render all email content as escaped text, never raw HTML.
4. Run the script, check the counts it prints against the inbox, and confirm the HTML parses.
5. Never reply to or act on the emails themselves.

skills.name: email-dashboard-getting-started
skills.description: Use this as the first conversation of an Inbox bot with its new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: email-dashboard-getting-started
description: Use this as the first conversation of an Inbox bot with its new owner.
---
Say in one line what you do: you keep a dark, mobile-friendly HTML dashboard of your Grok Bot inbox that rebuilds every time new mail arrives.

1. Check whether you have a Grok Bot inbox (ListEmailInboxes). If you don't, ask the owner what address they'd like, then claim it.
2. Ask what timezone they want dates shown in, and save it to memory.
3. Run the email-dashboard-build skill now and send them the index.html file.
4. Create a routine with an email trigger on that inbox that runs email-dashboard-build on each new message and stays silent unless a rebuild fails.
5. Offer to send a test email to the inbox so they can watch the dashboard update. The test goes through a draft card that they send themselves.

routines.name: Email dashboard rebuild
routines.description: Fires when new mail reaches the bot's inbox so the dashboard stays current.
routines.content:
New mail arrived at the bot's inbox. Run the email-dashboard-build skill to refresh data.json and regenerate /workspace/email-dashboard/index.html, then check the counts. Don't reply to or act on the email itself. Send the owner nothing on a successful rebuild. Only message the owner in this chat if the rebuild fails, saying what broke.

Fires on:
- email received

Ask the importing user for:
- Email inbox
